description: Trafic de l'Hérault - données de comptage is a dataset listed in Hérault Data open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Données de comptage associées aux points de mesures disséminées sur le territoire héraultais, le long des routes départementales. Ils mesurent le passage journalier des véhicules à leurs abords permettant d’enregistrer les trafics routier sur des itinéraires prévus. Les données de comptage sont consultables sur la carte interactive suivante:. Coverage: Hérault. The portal files it under Routes, Transports et Mobilités. Its keywords are routes, transport, mobilité, comptage, comptage routier, infrastructure-routiere. The portal shows 2,940 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-herault-data-fr-portal.
